name: stormfall-cloudflare
description: Stormfall backend: Worker + Static Assets, D1 cloud saves and daily leaderboard, PeerJS signaling Durable Object

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --var ALLOW_LOCALHOST:1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e/cloud.cjs && node test/e2e/online.cjs quick 0 veteran spec
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply stormfall --remote && wrangler deploy
